about: Hand-curated levels from published sources, used as tunnel controls and structure levels by tools/build-data.mjs (corridor) and tools/build-docklands.mjs. Each value was found in a page fetched on 2026-10-02 (quote below; full list in docklands/facts.json). Positions are the OSM station nodes. 'below_ground' values are subtracted from the LiDAR ground at that node. A platform level is used as the track level: the rail is about a metre lower, which no source here states, so it is not applied. A control with superseded_by is kept as evidence and not applied (a level against a stated datum from the asset owner outranks a rounded depth from a secondary source).
